Raven's Doomsday Flight is shot like a mock documentary. It starts with a raven's strange migration and slowly unfolds the beginning of the apocalypse.
From a bird's perspective, it portrays a post-apocalyptic world where the environment mutates and human civilization struggles to survive.
Raven's Post-Revelation is a sequel to Raven's Doomsday Flight. It keeps the mock documentary style and follows two generations of ravens through their natural behavior and long journey.
It focuses on rebuilding and recovery after the disaster, all seen through a bird's eyes.

Orange Highway is a remake of a Golden Age sci-fi classic. After Earth's resources run dry, humanity survives by extracting a liquid energy source called Orange Flow from the planet's core.
The story follows an ordinary transport driver who stumbles onto a secret that could destroy Orange Flow.
By chance, he ends up escorting a human doctor across the continent to an Arctic research base, even though he's a mutant himself.
